senses.zh_definition: Tse：可用作华人姓氏的罗马字拼写，例如粤语姓氏“谢”；当前输入不足以确定对应汉字及具体指称。
senses.en_definition: Tse, a romanized Chinese surname, including a Cantonese spelling of 謝; the intended character and referent are unverified.
senses.ms_definition: Tse ialah bentuk ejaan Rumi bagi nama keluarga Cina, antaranya 謝 dalam bahasa Kantonis; aksara dan rujukan khusus dalam input ini belum dikenal pasti.
senses.nuances: 此处仅记录可证实的姓氏用法，不能据此确认该语料项的身份，也不能自动将其还原为某个汉字或大写缩略语 TSE。无已核定的普通马来语释义，因此状态标为 unverified。下列为姓氏用法示例，不声称为高频搭配。[FamilySearch：Tse 姓氏资料](https://www.familysearch.org/en/surname?surname=tse)

etymology.historical_story: Tse illustrates how Chinese surnames can retain romanized spellings associated with a particular spoken language. The surname reference records it as a Cantonese form of 謝 and also notes another surname association. Consequently, the Latin letters alone cannot securely recover someone's Chinese characters, pronunciation, or family history. [Surname reference](https://www.familysearch.org/en/surname?surname=tse)
